tools.name: labubu_rarity_odds
tools.description: Commonly reported secret/chase odds for Labubu / The Monsters blind-box series, by series format (6-figure, 12-figure, collabs, glow variants), with per-row sources. The box-printed odds for a specific series outrank every row returned here, and the result says so.

tools.name: labubu_fake_signals
tools.description: The eight authenticity checks for a Labubu figure (teeth count, face finish, box finish, anti-counterfeit seal, figure markings, build quality, price floor, seller of record), each with its named public sources. Compiled signals, not a guarantee; limitations are included.

tools.name: secret_pull_probability
tools.description: Probability of pulling at least one secret across N blind boxes at printed odds of 1-in-oddsN, plus the box counts a 50% and 90% chance require. Independent single-box model — sealed whole-case allocation can differ, and the result carries that caveat.

tools.name: define_labubu_term
tools.description: Plain-language definition of a Labubu / blind-box collecting term (blind box, series, regular, secret/chase, printed odds, case, glow variant, vinyl plush pendant, Lafufu, seller of record). Matches the term or its aliases; an unknown term returns the list of available terms, honestly.

tools.name: calculate_style_probability
tools.description: Calculate independent-box chances for one regular style, a secret, or a user-supplied per-style probability. Required by mode: regular needs regularStyles and secretOddsN; secret needs secretOddsN; printed needs probabilityPercent. Regular mode assumes equally likely regular styles and replacement b

tools.name: find_collector_tools
tools.description: Find TDS collecting tools and guides by task. Returns canonical links, supported languages, inputs and which functions MCP can actually call. Browser-only collection records are never read.

tools.name: get_collecting_guide
tools.description: Read a published guide for one of eight collectible brands with official source links, review date and limitations. Not current stock, resale valuation or authentication.

tools.name: plan_display_fit
tools.description: Calculate a uniform single-layer rectangular layout for toy footprints inside a display case. All dimensions use the same unit. Tests 90-degree rotation when allowed; not 3D packing or a safety/load certification.

tools.name: compare_blind_box_budget
tools.description: Compare a capped independent blind-box budget with a user-supplied all-in confirmed-figure quote. Returns success and failure chances, maximum spend and expected spend when stopping at the first target. One currency, costs rounded to cents; not a purchase recommendation or price lookup.

tools.name: estimate_collection_progress
tools.description: Estimate new distinct regular styles, repeated regular draws and secret draws from independent boxes. Assumes equally likely regular styles after combined secret probability is removed. Owned means distinct regular styles from this exact series. Not sealed-case allocation or completion probability.
